prompt:
We're building the Serenity Coaching platform and need a newsletter signup form created as a standalone file called `newsletter-signup.html`.

We have a project context file already set up in the workspace that describes our audience, our current signup incentive, and some important constraints about what's already on the page. Please read that first before designing anything.

The form needs to actually work for our users — most of them are on mobile — and it has to be compliant with our privacy obligations. We've had accessibility complaints before so that needs to be airtight. There's already a form on the blog page collecting emails for a different purpose, so make sure whatever you create doesn't compete with or confuse that.

Deliver a complete, production-ready HTML file.
